verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show a Homebrew install path exists for the rcli tool. One user says 'not everything loads properly when installed via homebrew', another notes the install script itself installs Brew, and others report the install failed outright, so a quick, clean package-manager install is not demonstrated. missing for 10: first-party install documentation naming a standard package manager (brew/npm/pip/SPM/Gradle), evidence the install completes quickly and reliably, package-manager coverage for the SDK bindings.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager

citations.quote: not everything loads properly when installed via homebrew
